_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or point to a different path with the ARTEX_CONFIG environment variable). This file holds only two items: database and skill_dir. Other settings such as the LLM are left to environment variables or in-app settings and are not put in this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Choose one of two ways to write it: (A) fill in the individual fields below, or (B) fill in only a complete connection string in database.dsn.
_comment_database_dsn: Way (B): remove the database above and write a complete DSN instead. If dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory of skills (each subdirectory is one skill and contains SKILL.md). Priority: environment variable ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). If left empty or if this field is removed, the default is used. A relative path is resolved against the current working directory.
_comment_language: Default language for user-facing output (one of en, ko, zh, es, ja). Reports, summaries, chat replies generated by agents and backend messages follow this language. Priority: environment variable ARTEX_LANG > this field > default (en). While running, the value chosen in the settings screen overrides this default. If left empty or if this field is removed, the default (en) is used.
